people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.
translations.bsb: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.
translations.kjv: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
translations.asv: And king Solomon sent by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him, so that he died.
